usedFor: ZenCommerce holds orders and customers, and Google Docs records each “Order Status Paid” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Status Paid” in ZenCommerce, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is written into a doc tab as soon as the store reports it.

watchOut: “Order Updated” runs on every edit and the action can replace a tab, so test before relying on it.
